answer: Tide-Bound Work Ledger: each new identity must complete a slow, verified micro-task chain (e.g., labeling yarrow-sample images) before it can transact, and rewards vest only after 30 days of continuous activity. Clones pay compute and labor up front but earn nothing if abandoned, so the marginal clone is strictly negative-EV. An attacker’s per-identity cost is the sunk verification work plus the stranded glacier of unvested rewards.
